name: AI Vanguard
description: A Union-aligned bloc of artificial intelligences with political weight. Canon establishes it as the second leg of the alliance that elected Chancellor Zylox, alongside the Trade Coalition and economic technocrats, and records that it is "growing beyond his full control" — an autonomy pressure inside the Union rather than an external rogue-AI threat.
distinction_note: Distinct from the AI-Warlord Collective (polity_ai_warlord_collective), which is adversarial and external, and from the Prime Construct. The AI Vanguard is Union-aligned and politically embedded.
notes: Created 2026-08-09. A named political bloc attested in committed canon (chancellorship alliance; drifting from the Chancellor's control) that had no entity record. Attributes recovered from canon; its internal structure, leadership and membership are NOT established and were not invented.
